topIssues.title: kona: orphaned sources/variant.rs in kona-derive references non-existent AsyncIterator and stale API
topIssues.author: ajsutton
topIssues.body:
## Summary

`rust/kona/crates/protocol/derive/src/sources/variant.rs` exists in the kona-derive sources directory but is **not included in `sources/mod.rs`** and is therefore dead code. The file references:

- A non-existent `AsyncIterator` trait (not defined anywhere in the kona codebase)
- An outdated `CalldataSource::new(chain, block_ref, batcher_address)` 4-argument API that no longer matches the current 2-argument API

The file appears to be a leftover from the workspace migration (commit `48a7a09b`). It will fail to compile if added to the module tree. There is no runtime impact, but the file is misleading to developers browsing the source.

## Location

[`rust/kona/crates/protocol/derive/src/sources/variant.rs`](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/blob/a8a2956e695f18f53309ff0c30587a2a42961329/rust/kona/crates/protocol/derive/src/sources/variant.rs)

## Fix

Delete the file, or if there is a plan to restore it, update it to compile against the current API first.

## Context

Found during kona-node-vs-op-node conformance review (component: L1 Retrieval, finding LR-C05). Low priority — no runtime impact.

topPRs.title: test(contracts): convert GovernanceToken tests to fuzz tests
topPRs.author: devin-ai-integration
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Converts all 9 hardcoded tests in `GovernanceToken.t.sol` to fuzz tests, replacing fixed values with bounded fuzz parameters for broader input coverage. No new tests added — `GovernanceToken` only declares `constructor()` and `mint()` as public functions, both already covered.

**Changes per test contract:**

- **`GovernanceToken_Mint_Test`**: `test_mint_fromOwner_succeeds` now fuzzes `_account` and `_amount`; `test_mint_fromNotOwner_reverts` now fuzzes `_caller`
- **`GovernanceToken_Uncategorized_Test`**: All 7 inherited-function tests (burn, burnFrom, transfer, approve, transferFrom, increaseAllowance, decreaseAllowance) converted to fuzz with appropriate bounds

**Bound rationale:**
- Mint amounts bounded to `type(uint224).max` (matches `ERC20Votes._maxSupply()`)
- `increaseAllowance` params bounded to `type(uint128).max` each (prevents sum overflow)
- `decreaseAllowance` initial bounded to `type(uint192).max`, decrease bounded to initial

## Review & Testing Checklist for Human

- [ ] Verify the `type(uint224).max` bound for mint amounts correctly reflects `ERC20Votes._maxSupply()` — if the OZ version used differs, this could silently pass with an incorrect ceiling
- [ ] Confirm removing the unnecessary `mint()` call from `approve`, `increaseAllowance`, and `decreaseAllowance` tests doesn't lose any meaningful coverage (these functions don't depend on token balance)
- [ ] Run `just test-dev --match-path test/governance/GovernanceToken.t.sol -v` with higher fuzz runs (e.g., `FOUNDRY_FUZZ_RUNS=1000`) to increase confidence in edge cases

### Notes
- Inline comments documenting specific hardcoded values were removed since they no longer apply to fuzz parameters
- The `pre-pr` `semver-lock` failure is a pre-existing repo issue (missing source files for `OPSuccinctFaultDisputeGame.sol`, etc.) — unrelated to these test changes
- Link to Devin run: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/11157c6808504be4bf6fbb19f8204d0f
- Requested by: @aliersh

topPRs.author: devin-ai-integration
topPRs.body:
# test(contracts): improve LegacyMintableERC20 test coverage

## Summary

Enhances `LegacyMintableERC20` tests with fuzz testing and broader coverage:

- **Naming fixes**: Renamed `_works` → `_succeeds` / `_supportedIds_succeeds` to follow naming conventions
- **Fuzz conversions**: Converted 4 focused tests to fuzz tests (`mint`/`burn` success and revert paths) to test across address and amount ranges instead of single hardcoded values
- **Event emission checks**: Added `vm.expectEmit` assertions for `Mint` and `Burn` events
- **Coverage gap**: Added `testFuzz_supportsInterface_unsupportedId_succeeds` to cover the `false` return branch of `supportsInterface`

No source contract changes — test-only improvements on a deprecated/legacy contract.

## Review & Testing Checklist for Human

- [ ] Verify the re-declared `Mint`/`Burn` events in `TestInit` use camelCase param names (per semgrep rules) while the source contract uses underscore-prefixed names — confirm this doesn't affect event topic matching in `vm.expectEmit`
- [ ] Confirm `testFuzz_mint_byBridge_succeeds` fuzz constraints are sufficient: `_to != address(0)` covers ERC20's zero-address revert, but `_amount` is unbounded — verify no overflow risk given fresh state per fuzz run
- [ ] Run `just test-dev --match-path test/legacy/LegacyMintableERC20.t.sol -v` locally to confirm all 7 tests pass

### Notes
- The `just pre-pr` semver-lock step fails due to pre-existing missing source files (`OPSuccinctFaultDisputeGame.sol`, `FaultDisputeGameV2.sol`, etc.) — unrelated to this PR
- [Link to Devin run](https://app.devin.ai/sessions/52e9161d9b7f401c9d5b34afdd6c0473)
- Requested by: @aliersh

Changelog

Sourced from go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk's changelog.

[1.40.0/0.62.0/0.16.0] 2026-02-02

Added

  • Add AlwaysRecord sampler in go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/trace. (#7724)
  • Add Enabled method to all synchronous instrument interfaces (Float64Counter, Float64UpDownCounter, Float64Histogram, Float64Gauge, Int64Counter, Int64UpDownCounter, Int64Histogram, Int64Gauge,) in go.opentelemetry.io/otel/metric. This stabilizes the synchronous instrument enabled feature, allowing users to check if an instrument will process measurements before performing computationally expensive operations. (#7763)
  • Add go.opentelemetry.io/otel/semconv/v1.39.0 package. The package contains semantic conventions from the v1.39.0 version of the OpenTelemetry Semantic Conventions. See the migration documentation for information on how to upgrade from go.opentelemetry.io/otel/semconv/v1.38.0. (#7783, #7789)

Changed

  • Improve the concurrent performance of HistogramReservoir in go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/metric/exemplar by 4x. (#7443)
  • Improve the concurrent performance of FixedSizeReservoir in go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/metric/exemplar. (#7447)
  • Improve performance of concurrent histogram measurements in go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/metric. (#7474)
  • Improve performance of concurrent synchronous gauge measurements in go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/metric. (#7478)
  • Add experimental observability metrics in go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/stdout/stdoutmetric. (#7492)
  • Exporter in go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/prometheus ignores metrics with the scope go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/bridges/prometheus. This prevents scrape failures when the Prometheus exporter is misconfigured to get data from the Prometheus bridge. (#7688)
  • Improve performance of concurrent exponential histogram measurements in go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/metric. (#7702)
  • The rpc.grpc.status_code attribute in the experimental metrics emitted from go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace/otlptracegrpc is replaced with the rpc.response.status_code attribute to align with the semantic conventions. (#7854)
  • The rpc.grpc.status_code attribute in the experimental metrics emitted from go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlplog/otlploggrpc is replaced with the rpc.response.status_code attribute to align with the semantic conventions. (#7854)

Fixed

  • Fix bad log message when key-value pairs are dropped because of key duplication in go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/log. (#7662)
  • Fix DroppedAttributes on Record in go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/log to not count the non-attribute key-value pairs dropped because of key duplication. (#7662)
  • Fix SetAttributes on Record in go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/log to not log that attributes are dropped when they are actually not dropped. (#7662)
  • Fix missing request.GetBody in go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace/otlptracehttp to correctly handle HTTP/2 GOAWAY frame. (#7794)
  • WithHostID detector in go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/resource to use full path for ioreg command on Darwin (macOS). (#7818)

Deprecated

  • Deprecate go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/zipkin. For more information, see the OTel blog post deprecating the Zipkin exporter. (#7670)

[1.39.0/0.61.0/0.15.0/0.0.14] 2025-12-05

Added

  • Greatly reduce the cost of recording metrics in go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/metric using hashing for map keys. (#7175)
  • Add WithInstrumentationAttributeSet option to go.opentelemetry.io/otel/log, go.opentelemetry.io/otel/metric, and go.opentelemetry.io/otel/trace packages. This provides a concurrent-safe and performant alternative to WithInstrumentationAttributes by accepting a pre-constructed attribute.Set. (#7287)
  • Add experimental observability for the Prometheus exporter in go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/prometheus. Check the go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/prometheus/internal/x package documentation for more information. (#7345)
  • Add experimental observability metrics in go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlplog/otlploggrpc. (#7353)
  • Add temporality selector functions DeltaTemporalitySelector, CumulativeTemporalitySelector, LowMemoryTemporalitySelector to go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/metric. (#7434)
  • Add experimental observability metrics for simple log processor in go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk/log. (#7548)
  • Add experimental observability metrics in go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace/otlptracegrpc. (#7459)
